question: Will Anthropic’s IPO S-1 be public by 16 October 2026?
resolution_criteria:
Resolves YES if Anthropic’s Form S-1 registration statement for its proposed IPO becomes publicly accessible on the SEC’s EDGAR system by 23:59 New York time on 16 October 2026, inclusive.
A preliminary S-1 counts; final pricing and SEC approval are not required. Confidential submissions, leaked documents, and announcements or news reports without a publicly accessible S-1 on EDGAR do not count.
The IPO itself does not need to occur by the deadline. A subsequent postponement or cancellation does not reverse a qualifying YES. Otherwise, resolves NO.
research:
I can't settle this one, and I didn't directly check EDGAR. Reporting up to 10 October 2026 says no public Anthropic S-1 was on EDGAR as of 4 October. The listing target had slipped to November, which on the timeline below points to a public filing in late October rather than by 16 October. Several pages turned up dated after 10 October 2026, so I left them out. My page fetches were blocked by the proxy, so everything here comes from search-result summaries.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding source is SEC EDGAR, a full-text or company search for Anthropic, PBC. I couldn't query EDGAR live for the cutoff date.
- Searching EDGAR for "Anthropic" brings up unrelated filings, such as a Form D for an Anthropic-branded fund and an ETF filing. Check that any S-1 is from Anthropic, PBC itself. [finrep](https://www.finrep.ai/blog/anthropic-s-1-edgar-2026-what-finance-professionals-need-to-know)
- 2026-10-04: Forkast reported there was still no public Anthropic S-1 on EDGAR. EDGAR had shown no public Anthropic filing as of 26 September either. [Forkast](https://forkast.news/anthropics-public-s-1-still-missing-from-edgar-as-october-ipo-window-opens/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The only filing so far is the confidential draft from June 1, and confidential filings don't count.
- 2026-06-01: Anthropic confirmed it had confidentially submitted a draft registration statement for a proposed IPO. [Yahoo/AP](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/anthropic-confidentially-files-initial-public-163600968.html), [Michigan Public](https://www.michiganpublic.org/2026-06-01/ai-giant-anthropic-prepares-to-sell-stock-to-the-public-files-preliminary-ipo-paperwork)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-05: CNN reported the IPO could happen "as soon as November." [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/05/business/anthropic-ipo-stock-market)
- 2026-10-04: Forkast said it had been 126 days since the confidential filing with no public S-1. In its view, the missing filing is a "timing signal" pointing to November. It added that the public prospectus must be out at least 15 days before the roadshow. [Forkast](https://forkast.news/anthropics-public-s-1-still-missing-from-edgar-as-october-ipo-window-opens/)
- Around 2026-09-18/19: The WSJ, via secondhand reports, said the IPO moved from October to November so investors could see third-quarter results first. The quarter ended September 30. The reported target was a valuation of about $2T and a raise of up to $100B. [Digg summary](https://digg.com/ai/tu14otce), [hyper.ai](https://hyper.ai/en/stories/7c92cca0b743e35a5cd21c57f8cae9a9)
- 2026-09-05/06: Reuters reported marketing would start in mid-October with a listing just before the midterms. The public prospectus was no longer expected the following week but "not until late September," and was tied to finalizing a $15B revolving credit facility. That date passed without a filing. [Tribune India](https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/business/anthropic-pushes-back-ipo-timeline-eyes-mid-october-launch/), [The Standard](https://www.thestandard.com.hk/world/article/341919/Anthropic-IPO-launch-shifts-toward-mid-October-sources-say)
- Late August 2026: Reuters had expected the public S-1 shortly after Labor Day. It didn't come, which makes it at least the second missed expected date. [Forkast](https://forkast.news/the-anthropic-s-1-that-was-expected-after-labor-day-still-hasnt-arrived/)

## 4. Base rates
- Public filing has to come at least 15 calendar days before the roadshow starts. Big tech IPOs usually make the S-1 public about 3 to 5 weeks before pricing. [Forkast](https://forkast.news/anthropics-public-s-1-still-missing-from-edgar-as-october-ipo-window-opens/)
- Anthropic's expected public-filing dates have repeatedly slipped: after Labor Day, then late September, then not by October 4. I found no dated, sourced estimate of when the S-1 itself would go public.
- My own arithmetic, not a sourced forecast: a mid-to-late November listing with a 1 to 2 week roadshow means a roadshow starting around early November and a public S-1 by about mid-to-late October. Filing by October 16 would mean a listing near the early end of "November."
- Adding Q3 numbers (quarter ended September 30) to the S-1 could take several weeks after quarter-end. That leans against a filing in the first half of October, but I found no source confirming whether Q3 financials will be in the initial public S-1.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Action Network, undated, roughly late September or early October: Polymarket put about 68% on an Anthropic IPO before the end of 2026. On the date ladder, October was 39% and December 68%. The piece recommended buying No on the October listing at 62¢. It called a public S-1 "in the next two weeks" the main risk to that trade. [Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/politics/anthropic-is-the-only-2026-ipo-polymarket-still-believes-in), [Action Network 2](https://www.actionnetwork.com/politics/anthropic-ipo-date-given-clear-timeframe-in-polymarket-odds)
- Another snapshot, undated: Polymarket at 54% for an IPO by November 30, 74% by December 15 and 79% by December 31. [Coingape](https://coingape.com/prediction-markets/will-anthropic-ipo-by-december-31-2026-odds-at-79/)
- Manifold has a market on when Anthropic's public S-1 will appear, plus a "which week" market. I couldn't load either to get current prices. [Manifold S-1](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/will-anthropics-public-form-s1-appe), [Manifold week](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/which-week-will-anthropics-ipo-pros)
- I found no Polymarket or Kalshi market resolving specifically on a public S-1 by October 16, and no current price snapshot.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (10 to 16 October)
- A public S-1 on EDGAR, the only thing that resolves YES. Watch for Bloomberg or Reuters reports that it is "said to plan public filing" in the coming days, which usually come out 0 to 3 days ahead.
- Q3 close and any leaked Q3 revenue figures. Those would suggest financials are nearly ready to include.
- News on the $15B revolving credit facility closing, which Reuters linked to the next steps of the IPO process.
- Any market shock, or a decision to slip past the U.S. midterms (November 3), could delay things further.
